name: Measure Double Star in HST NGC 6652 Image
description: An HST WFPC2 V-band (F555W) image of globular cluster NGC 6652 is open in AstroImageJ at ~/AstroImages/double_star/ngc6652_555w.fits. A target star pair has been marked in the file target_pair.txt with approximate pixel coordinates. Using AstroImageJ, locate this close star pair and measure: (1) the angular separation in arcseconds (using the WFPC2 WF chip plate scale of 0.1 arcsec/pixel noted in the FITS header comments), (2) the position angle of the secondary relative to the primary (measured North through East), and (3) the approximate magnitude difference between the two components using aperture photometry. Save your measurements to a text file called double_star_results.txt in the working directory, with clearly labeled values for separation (arcsec), position angle (degrees), and magnitude difference. Login credentials: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
